goal_contract.current_milestone: Real use over several normal work sessions, then one outside-user installation test. The local control loop milestone (revision 1) is COMPLETE, proven end to end on PhotoSahi and closed on 2026-07-27.
goal_contract.desired_outcome: Turn a mature AI discussion into an executable project contract, keep all agents aligned with it, verify repository evidence, and involve the human only for genuine exceptions.
goal_contract.exact_next_action: Use DogBuild normally for real work across several sessions and record what breaks or gets in the way. Build no new feature until that evidence exists.
explicit_exclusions: new features before the real-use evidence exists
goal_contract.problem: Solo developers lose project purpose, current state, decisions, and context while moving work between ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, and multiple repositories.
goal_contract.target_user: Solo developers who explore projects in ChatGPT and implement them with Claude Code or Codex.
unresolved_assumptions: that ordinary use will surface problems the built acceptance tests did not
that an outside user can install DogBuild without the owner present
goal_contract.why_now: The local control loop is complete and proven on a real repository. What is unproven is whether it survives ordinary use and whether anyone else can install it.
